name: dropdown-menu

frames.best_why: Menu is fully open with every row readable and no cursor covering an item.

tagline: Outlined button drops open a narrow list of account actions.
summary: A compact account menu: an outlined button opens a rounded dark panel with a muted heading, icon rows carrying shortcut hints, a ticked toggle row and signed-out action, all stacked with faint dividers.
appearance: A small outlined 'Open menu' button on black. Opening it shows a narrow dark rounded panel with a muted 'My account' heading, four icon rows with tiny keys on the right, a ticked 'Show status bar' row, a 'Team' row and 'Log out', split by thin rules.
behaviour: Clicking the button fades and zooms in a menu just below it. Passing over a row highlights it in a slightly lighter grey; choosing a row or clicking outside closes the panel, and the tick toggles in place.
demo_content: An account menu with Profile, Billing, Settings, Keyboard shortcuts, Show status bar, Team and Log out.
search_phrases: list of actions that pops open
button that reveals a small list
use_when: A trigger needs to open a short list of account or row actions without leaving the page.
avoid_when: Rows are single-line and the panel is narrow, so long labels or dozens of actions need another pattern.
customise: You compose the label, groups, rows, dividers and shortcut hints yourself; width, inset and the destructive row styling are set per part through props and classes.
weight_why: A small portal panel that exists only while the menu is open.

a11y.note: Roles and arrow-key movement come from the menu primitive, but the zoom and slide animations ignore reduced-motion settings.

issues: Shortcut glyphs such as the shift-command keys are tiny and low contrast
No frame shows the submenu or radio rows that the source exports
polish_why: Tidy, standard account menu; tiny shortcut keys and an all-dark palette on black.
